node.statement: Quantitative premise extraction at every amplification. Use the amended registered def-four-corner-merging-datum (the registration containing the 2026-07-25 quantitative-complementarity amendment): its common defect rho says that each target P_i is a rho-projection, so P_i^dagger=P_i and ||P_i^2-P_i||_1<=rho, and that ||P_1+P_2-I||_1<=rho. For p_i=I_n tensor P_i and r=I_n tensor(P_1+P_2-I), matrix multiplication and involution give p_i^dagger=p_i and p_i^2-p_i=I_n tensor(P_i^2-P_i). Each such amplification is the diagonal direct sum of n copies of its level-one entry; iterating the registered Ruan axiom ax_R2 therefore gives ||I_n tensor x||_n=||x||_1. Consequently ||p_i^2-p_i||_n<=rho and ||r||_n<=rho, uniformly in n. These are definition-supplied premises, not consequences of the four corner-map clauses.
